name: releasemyad-newspaper-ads
description: Newspaper ad rates, the right paper for your city, the exact cost of your ad text and the earliest publish date, for Indian newspapers.

interface.longDescription: Planning a newspaper advertisement in India? releaseMyAd answers the questions that need live data: which newspapers carry your ad category in your city, with language, circulation and the current rate side by side; what one newspaper charges in each edition; the exact cost of your ad text counted the way that paper bills it, including GST; whether the text is over the paper's length limit; which documents the paper needs (for example a notarised affidavit for a change of name ad); and the earliest date the ad can still be published. Covers matrimonial, property, recruitment, obituary, change of name, public notice, lost documents and other classified categories. When you are ready, it saves your ad and gives you a link to releasemyad.com where you can still edit the wording, pick publish dates and complete the booking. The plugin itself does not take payment.
defaultPrompt: Which Hindi newspaper should I use for a matrimonial ad in Lucknow, and what will it cost?
How much will my change of name ad cost in Times of India Delhi?
Can my public notice appear in Hindustan Times Delhi tomorrow?
